articles.summary: BEIJING, Sept. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- iQIYI, Inc. (Nasdaq: IQ) (“iQIYI” or the “Company”), a leading provider of online entertainment video services in China, today unveiled the trailer of its first full-length hybrid AI multi-season drama “Immortals Over Mortal Love”.
articles.title: iQIYI Unveils the Trailer of Its First Full-Length Hybrid AI Multi-Season Drama “Immortals Over Mortal Love”
